## Prompt

This PR adds only `proposals/<slug>/prompt.md`.

## Ownership

- [ ] I wrote or have permission to submit this prompt.
- [ ] I understand an AI agent may interpret it unpredictably.
- [ ] The request does not ask for network access, credentials, tracking, impersonation, harassment, or illegal content.

## What should people want to share?

Describe the one delightful or surprising moment in the proposed world.
